text:
Hi Larkspur team,

I'm planning a really special day - my sister's wedding, and I'd love to make it even more unforgettable by hiring the 1961 Hartwell Kestrel for the occasion. We'd pick it up on Thursday 21 May 2027 at 12:00 pm and return it on 23/05/2027 at 10:30 am, collecting it from your garage in the meantime. I was wondering if it could be brought to us with one of your chauffeurs driving, and decorated with some lovely ribbons and flowers on the car. It would be a wonderful touch.

Best,
Nell Marrowby
+70 473 493 2027
